name: hook-catalog-v1
status: proposed (aweb-acgh.16.1); frozen once reviewed, after which any payload change is a new catalog version

scheme.authority: docs/hook-events.md is normative; this file is its machine-readable catalog
scheme.payload: a flat JSON object; every value is a string, integer, boolean or list of strings; no nested objects, floats or nulls
scheme.unknown_fields: refused, at every level of the catalog file and in every payload
scheme.integers: JSON integers only; a boolean or a float is never an integer
scheme.lists: lists hold unique items of one type, within the stated bounds
scheme.rules: each rule applies when its 'when' holds: 'in' lists the matching values, 'present' matches a present field; 'require' and 'forbid' name fields, 'require_equals' names a field and its only allowed value, 'require_in' names a field and its allowed values
scheme.audit_critical: always: every event; widening_acts: acts whose catalog direction is widening; never: no event
scheme.precedence: a tool call whose effect a specific hook covers fires only that hook
scheme.order: checks run in this order and report the first fault: the hook is known; for a hook with a discriminator, the discriminator's value; unknown fields; missing required fields; each value against its type, bounds and constants, in field-name order; the rules in their listed order; then the act's catalog direction (post-governance-hook) or the command class's effects (post-command-hook)
scheme.cases: a case gives its payload as JSON ('payload'), or as JSON text ('payload_json') when the payload holds a value this file may not, such as a float

excluded_core_events.reservation.acquired: Reservations are operational locks, not coordination effects.
excluded_core_events.reservation.renewed: Reservations are operational locks, not coordination effects.
excluded_core_events.reservation.released: Reservations are operational locks, not coordination effects.
excluded_core_events.agent.status: Status reports are health signals, not coordination effects.
